About.title: About Bunga Wisata
About.metaDescription: The Bunga Wisata story — our team, our experience, and how we build trips.
About.intro: Bunga Wisata has been planning trips since 2015 — from a short weekend at Bromo to a nine-day journey through Türkiye — with itineraries laid out clearly from day one and a team that stays with you until you're home.
About.story: Our first trip was a group of a dozen people headed to Bromo, arranged entirely over WhatsApp with no office to speak of — the itinerary was written by hand, printed, and handed out the night before departure. From there the requests kept coming: first from relatives, then colleagues, then communities passing our name along by word of mouth. Ten years on, with a permanent office in Karangploso and routes stretching from Sabang to Cappadocia, we still hold to what that first trip taught us: itineraries laid out clearly upfront, prices that don't shift mid-trip, and a tour leader who genuinely knows the route travelling with every group.

honest.title: Honest pricing
honest.description: Every package lists what's included and excluded before you pay the deposit — no surprise costs appearing partway through the trip.

personal.title: Personal support
personal.description: Every group, large or small, travels with a tour leader who's one WhatsApp message away — not a rotating cast of customer service numbers.

detail.title: Details handled
detail.description: From tickets and accommodation to attraction entry permits, we handle it all in advance so the only thing left for you to think about is enjoying the trip.
